mapper.select: SELECT * FROM place_reviews ORDER BY created_at DESC

WITH review_stats AS ( SELECT place_id, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = false ) AS stored_review_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = false) AND COALESCE(images, '') ~* 'https?://' ) AS image_review_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = false) AND COALESCE(images, '') ~* 'onestudy\.id\.vn' ) AS managed_image_review_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = false) AND REGEXP_REPLACE( COALESCE(images, ''), 'https?://[^" ]*onestudy\.id\.vn[^" ]*', '', 'gi' ) ~* 'https?://' ) AS external_image_review_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = false) AND COALESCE(images, '') ~* '(googleusercontent\.com|ggpht\.com)' ) AS google_image_review_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = false) AND (authenticity_score IS NULL OR score_calculated_at IS NULL) ) AS recalculation_needed_count FROM place_reviews GROUP BY place_id ) SELECT p.id, p.place_id, p.title, p.google_maps_link, p.visibility_status, p.score_sample_count, p.score_calculated_at, p.last_scraped_at, COALESCE(rs.stored_review_count, 0) AS stored_review_count, COALESCE(rs.image_review_count, 0) AS image_review_count, COALESCE(rs.managed_image_review_count, 0) AS managed_image_review_count, COALESCE(rs.external_image_review_count, 0) AS external_image_review_count, COALESCE(rs.google_image_review_count, 0) AS google_image_review_count, COALESCE(rs.recalculation_needed_count, 0) AS recalculation_needed_count FROM places p LEFT JOIN review_stats rs ON rs.place_id = p.id WHERE p.visibility_status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.google_maps_link IS NOT NULL AND BTRIM(p.google_maps_link) != ''
AND p.id = #{placeId}
AND ( COALESCE(rs.stored_review_count, 0) = 0 OR COALESCE(rs.image_review_count, 0) = 0 OR COALESCE(rs.external_image_review_count, 0) > 0 )
AND ( COALESCE(rs.external_image_review_count, 0) > 0 OR p.last_scraped_at IS NULL OR p.last_scraped_at <= #{cutoff} )
ORDER BY COALESCE(rs.google_image_review_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(rs.recalculation_needed_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(rs.external_image_review_count, 0) DESC, COALESCE(p.score_sample_count, 0) ASC, p.last_scraped_at ASC NULLS FIRST, p.created_at ASC

SELECT * FROM place_reviews WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = false) ORDER BY authenticity_score DESC NULLS LAST, likes DESC, review_date DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT AVG(authenticity_score) FROM place_reviews WHERE place_id = #{placeId} AND (is_deleted IS NULL OR is_deleted = false) AND authenticity_score IS NOT NULL
